The 2x current error most likely comes from fingering: `n.M` seems to treat W as per-finger, so `m=2` doubled the device. That would explain why vout_dc and power came out about 1.9x off. Swing appears to be measured symmetrically around vout_dc (2×0.61 ≈ 1.22 V). So I set the device to one finger, centre vout near 0.95 V, and set Rl so Id stays near 65 µA to meet the power budget.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "W probably doubled by m=nf fingers (n.M W likely per-finger), so vout fell to 0.59 V and power rose. Use m=1 and centre vout at about 0.95 V for symmetric swing. Choose Rl so Id is about 65 uA (power about 135 uW). L=0.3 keeps gout high enough for f3db>25 MHz and gain>18 dB."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Rl":  (13e3, 12e3, 15e3),   # load resistor to VDD [ohm]
    "Ln":  (0.3,  0.2,  0.5),    # NMOS driver length [um]
    "vt":  (0.95, 0.85, 1.05),   # target vout_dc used to size Wn [V]
    "Wb":  (1.0,  0.5,  4.0),    # ibias sink diode width [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Rl, Ln, vt, Wb = p["Rl"], p["Ln"], p["vt"], p["Wb"]
    Lb = 1.0

    I_need = (VDD - vt) / Rl
    I_unit = lut.op("n", 1.0, Ln, vin, vt)["Id"]
    Wn = max(0.42, min(100.0, I_need / max(I_unit, 1e-12)))

    def kcl(v):
        return (VDD - v) / Rl - lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, v)["Id"]

    lo, hi = 0.02, VDD - 0.001
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if kcl(mid) > 0:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    vout = 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout)
    G = 1.0 / Rl
    gm = on["gm"]
    gout = on["gds"] + G
    gain = gm / gout
    ctot = cl + 0.1 * on["cgg"] + 10e-15
    f3db = gout / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = gain * f3db
    Id = (VDD - vout) / Rl
    power = VDD * (Id + iref)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vout - 0.02, VDD - vout)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln, m=1)
    n.R("RL", "vdd", "vout", Rl)
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lb)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(gain, 1e-6)),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
